# Apply by slot ($SLOT$ = a/b/c).
xar_apply_curse_effect = {
	if = { limit = { global_var:xa_curse_$SLOT$ = 0 } add_character_modifier = { modifier = xar_pc_drain_a days = 3650 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:xa_curse_$SLOT$ = 1 } add_character_modifier = { modifier = xar_pc_drain_b days = 3650 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:xa_curse_$SLOT$ = 2 } add_character_modifier = { modifier = xar_pc_drain_c days = 3650 } }
	if = { limit = { global_var:xa_curse_$SLOT$ = 3 } add_character_modifier = { modifier = xar_pc_drain_d days = 3650 } }
